thread:
ria (Marketing): Quick sync thread — PartnerCloud marketplace listing + joint webinar idea. Partner wants a dedicated launch post, webinar (45m), and a short benchmark highlight for the listing. Looking to go live in ~3.5 weeks. Who can take what?

derek (Partnerships): We can commit to co-hosting and provide a one-slide benchmark and partner logo pack. Prefer week of May 12 for webinar. Partner legal needs 72 hours for quote approvals.

lee (Growth): For lead flow: route registrants into SFDC campaign 'PC_Marketplace_Launch_May' and mark lead_source=partnercloud. We'll need tracking params and a direct webhook into our lead ingestion lambda. Also recommend gating recording to capture contact info.

tess (Content): Plan: 1) short marketplace blurb (2-3 bullets), 2) longer launch blog (600-900 words) that can be repurposed as the marketplace description, 3) short email announcement copy. I can draft the blurb + email by Tue afternoon. Need benchmark slide + 1-2 screenshots.

ria (Marketing): Owners: tess -> content, lee -> routing/tracking, derek -> partner assets & legal. I'll handle promo calendar and social.

derek (Partnerships): We'll deliver: logos (svg/png), slide PNG, speaker bios, and a csv of benchmark numbers by Mon. Customer case might be possible, I'll confirm.

lee (Growth): Registration fields: first/last name, email, company, role, expected monthly requests (range), and consent checkbox. Hidden field "pc_ref" for mapping. Add UTMs: utm_source=partnercloud, utm_campaign=pc_may_launch. Also, can we set conversion event in Segment for webinar_signups?

tess (Content): For the long blog, can we include a small benchmark table (3 rows) comparing token-cost and 95th latency versus baseline? Will need eng sign-off on numbers. If eng can't provide exacts, we'll use ranges and callouts like "up to 40%" with hedging.

ria (Marketing): Good constraint. @eng-platform — can you sign off on a 1-line stat we can quote on cost/latency by Fri? Don't want to overpromise.

deploy-bot: Reminder: Marketing release calendar updated — slot open May 15-19.

derek (Partnerships): Partner prefers May 16 for marketplace push to align with their newsletter. Is May 16 workable for webinar or should we do May 14?

lee (Growth): May 16 webinar is fine but prefer May 14 if we need an extra promo day. Also, set webinar timezone to 10am PT to maximize APAC overlap.

tess (Content): I'll aim for May 16 assets then. Drafts: blurb + email by Tue; long post by next Thu. Need partner quote and slide.

ria (Marketing): Promo cadence: 3 weeks out — teaser announcement, 2 weeks — registration open, 1 week — reminder sequence, 2 days — final push. Social copy + banners to be ready 10 days before.

derek (Partnerships): Confirming assets timeline: logos + slide + speaker bios by Mon; partner quote approval by Wed.

lee (Growth): I'll provision SFDC campaign + webhook endpoint. @eng-platform — can you provide auth method (JWT or api-key) and endpoint by EOD Mon?

tess (Content): Quick ask — can someone record a 60s highlight demo during rehearsal for social cuts? Even a phone capture is fine.

ria (Marketing): We'll schedule a 20m dry run with partner a week before. Assigning resources: @prod-design for social banners; @video for clip capture.

derek (Partnerships): Noted. I'll coordinate the dry run and speaker lineup. Will check on customer permission for a joint quote.

lee (Growth): Next steps recap in bullet: tess drafts copy (due Tue), lee sets up tracking + SFDC (due Mon), derek provides assets + quote (due Wed), ria finalizes promo calendar + design briefs (due Thu).

tess (Content): Added a Notion page and assigned sub-tasks. I'll ping when drafts are up for review.

ria (Marketing): Great. If no objections I'll lock May 16 as target and start outreach tomorrow. :rocket:

derek (Partnerships): Good to go from partner side. Excited to run this together. :handshake:

lee (Growth): All systems go on routing side.
